key_insight: PAPERBENCHX reveals a substantial gap between AI agents understanding scientific papers and reproducing their claims with independently verifiable evidence.
engineering_relevance: Reliable AI-driven science requires agents that can operate specialized software, make sound physical and numerical choices, and deliver reproducible workflows.
method: Benchmark 93 expert-constructed reproduction tasks across 12 research areas.
Provide each agent with a source paper, task specification, and domain-native scientific environment.
Replay submissions from scratch and score regenerated evidence against expert-validated criteria.
evidence_signal: Across 10 frontier agent configurations, the best fully reproduced only 14% of tasks at a 90% scoring threshold, while mean rubric scores ranged from 27.53% to 59.08%.
watch_item: Strong partial rubric scores should not be mistaken for successful reproduction of the target scientific claim.
paper_title: PAPERBENCHX: Can AI Reproduce Science Across Disciplines?
